tests.description: Timed check on Euthanasia and the Afterlife

questions.question: Explain two religious views on euthanasia.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Catholics oppose euthanasia because life is sacred and God-given — only God should end it. Job 1:21 states "The Lord gives and the Lord takes away." Suffering can have spiritual meaning, and the hospice movement offers palliative care as an alternative. 2) Islam forbids euthanasia because life belongs to Allah and only he can take it (Surah 17:33).
